title: SC04 artifact.schema.json -- Knowledge Artifact (05-DATA-MODEL.md §1, §5.3 scope, §6 Artifact columns) + CM-65 assertion<->evidence binding
description: The durable unit that reaches the resident layer (rule / skill / doc / script / test / lint / eval). Written ONLY by S12 kd_write_txn. Field set is closed by 05 §6; CM-65 (evidence-grounded-artifact-claims, MUST) is encoded by `claims[]` + `evidence_refs[]`: every strong identifier asserted in the body must be bound to an evidence ref whose line window contains it verbatim, and S12 re-checks that mechanically before the write (10-PROVENANCE-MODEL.md §1.4 L4).

artifact_id.description: Store key. No path separators: the record filename is derived from it by S12.

kind.description: 05 §1: Knowledge Artifact = 落到常驻层的产物（rule / skill / doc / script / test / lint / eval）.

content_hash.description: 05 §5.2 sha256(normalized body bytes). Consumers: exact-equality dedup, content-equality short-circuit, and the comparison target that makes verification[].artifact_sha expire.

canonical_key.description: 05 §5.1 L0: sha256(canonical 字段 NUL-join)[0:40]. L0 is the only layer with automatic counting and write authority.

identity.description: L1 (near-match) is advisory and L2 (embedding) is 不采用, so neither appears as a stored identity column. The canonical field list itself is DEFERRED (05 §7 DM-1) -- the shape is pinned, the inputs are not.

scope.description: 05 §5.3: typed triple, non-empty and fail-closed (S1) -- no default to global; counters are bucketed per scope (S3); a Project Rule and a Global Rule are two different terminal states (S4). This closes the Round 1 finding that a computed cohort was never consumed (RT-05 / DD-6).

body.description: 正文. 07 §A3 protects the fact body: wording may be updated in place, a factual change must go through SUPERSEDE.

claims.description: CM-65 assertion<->evidence binding. One entry per assertion that carries strong identifiers (filenames, symbols, ids, flags, numbers quoted as fact). Every entry must bind to an evidence ref index; S12 refuses the write when an identifier is not present verbatim inside that ref's line window (10 §1.4). An artifact may not be promoted on prose it cannot re-check.

strong_identifiers.description: Checked as a literal set difference against the cited evidence window; a non-empty stray list means the write is refused (`_unsupported_addresses` shape, CM-47 11:evidence-grounded-identifier-check).

evidence_ref_index.description: Index into evidence_refs[]. Binding by index keeps this schema self-contained; it is re-checked against the resolved file, not against a remembered string.

evidence_refs.description: 05 §2 row 3. path must be a canonical repository-relative path, brace/glob shorthand forbidden; the resolver (S14) validates it and a failure refuses the write. `lines` is required because S14's contract resolves 'a real file plus a line range inside it' -- Round 2 names the five keys but leaves the range's carrier open (see W1-C-REPORT.md IMPLEMENTATION_GAPS).

path.description: Single openable path, relative to its registered root: no leading slash, no braces, no glob, no ellipsis. Enforced by S14, expressible here as a pattern.

status.description: 05 §2 row 4: only the eval/audit runner may write VERIFIED; with no run record the value can only be UNVERIFIED.

provenance.description: The subset of the SC06 minimum-sufficient set that S13 stamps at write time. The rest of the eleven fields is held by the provenance record addressed through record_locator -- 出处记录不得由被记录对象持有 (10 §3).

model_id.description: null on the zero-LLM path; never a guessed value (12 §16 item 6).

created_at.description: Written once. Any rewrite produces a new entry linked by lifecycle_event (05 §2 row 6).

actor.description: 05 §2 row 5: written by the gateway/assembly layer, never self-reported; absence is fail-closed, so there is no 'unknown' value.

stamp_digest.description: Binding digest over the stamp; S12 re-derives it from runtime facts, which is what makes a self-filled block detectable.

absorbed_into.description: 05 §6 + 07 §3.4: on MERGE/absorb this must be non-empty AND the target must already exist or be created by the same batch; missing means the whole intent is refused fail-closed ('归档了一簇但没归并' was undetectable in incident #29912).

state.description: The six stored states; physical removal is not a state. SC05 (S17 semantics) owns lifecycle state. S12 writes this SC04 projection from the assembled SC05 in the same transaction and readers check agreement. A proposal may only carry state='candidate'; it cannot self-promote. ARCHIVE remains reversible; RESTORE is an explicitly authorized committed-history inverse, not physical deletion.

revision.description: Incremented only by kd_gate.apply_mutation; S12 uses it as the stale-write guard.

written_by.description: CM-30 write-ownership boundary: any record in the store that does not carry this exact value was written by a second write path.

verification.description: 05 §2 row 7: appended by the eval runner, the body may never edit an existing verdict. An empty array is legal and means 'no eval has run' -- it must render as UNKNOWN in reports (D5), never as a pass.

artifact_sha.description: Mismatch against the current content_hash expires this verdict.

refs_integrity.description: 05 §2 row 11: recomputed by S14 every round, fail-on-unresolved, exit 2. An empty ref set reports EMPTY_REF_SET, which is not a pass.

basis.description: Which run of which script produced this bit -- a self-declared integrity bit is not an integrity bit.

record_locator.description: 05 §2 row 10: the body keeps only a pointer into the store-side ledger; the authoritative provenance trail is not held by the recorded object. SYSTEM-OWNED (RH-P0-09 / §15): allocated by S12 after authorisation, never chosen by a proposal -- S12 refuses an intent whose record already carries record_locator (a forged locator must not become the final one).

patch_count.description: 05 §3: strictly separated from use; patch earns no support points. SYSTEM-OWNED (RH-P0-09): set by S12/assembly, a proposal carrying it is refused.

lifecycle_record_id.description: RH-P1-02 single-owner link: lifecycle state + counters (use_count/view_count/layer_request_count/opportunity_anchor/first_seen_at/pinned/referenced_by_external) live ONLY in the SC05 lifecycle-record, whose sole writer is S17 kd_lifecycle. The artifact keeps this stable reference instead of a second copy, so those SC05-owned columns were removed from SC04 -- one semantic, one authoritative owner.

produced_by.description: Declares who authored the payload. kd_provenance.is_self_generated consumes it (with locator/record_type as backup signals) so a model payload cannot launder itself into independent support; it is one of several signals, never the only one.
